hook: A 63-qubit processor simulated electric flux strings in a 2D lattice gauge theory.
summary: Researchers evolved strings with static or dynamical charges on superconducting qubits and observed rapid spreading when deconfined and suppressed spreading at strong fields. Gauss-law constraints, ancilla checks and noise rescaling controlled errors through up to 15 Trotter steps. The model is a small Z2 theory, not the full forces of nature.
title: Nonperturbative string dynamics in a (2+1)D lattice gauge theory on a superconducting quantum processor
